note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate, soldier and worker are described; one alate head length is omitted because of OCR damage; synonymy citations, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule reddish yellow to chestnut brown; base of nasus red, darker distally; antennae light brown; pronotum much paler than head, anterior lobe darker; legs straw yellow to brownish yellow; abdomen dorsally straw yellow to yellowish brown. Head sparsely hairy, with a few minute hairs; nasus with a few long hairs and several short hairs; anterior margin of pronotum with a few short hairs, lateral margins with one or two longer hairs; tergites and sternites with a few long setae and numerous short hairs. Body length 3.3–4.0 mm. Head pyriform, slightly longer than wide; posterior margin straight (1.43–1.70 mm long including nasus, 0.87–1.05 mm long excluding nasus, 0.83–1.05 mm maximum width); in lateral view nearly straight, nasus swelling weak. Nasus slightly conical; slightly longer than half the head length excluding nasus (0.60–0.65 mm long). Antennae 12-segmented; segment 3 subequal to segment 2 or slightly longer and slender. Mandibles vestigial, each with a small apical process. Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.13–0.25 mm long, 0.41–0.53 mm wide); anterior margin not distinctly notched, posterior margin nearly straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule light brown; remainder of body straw yellow. Head sparsely hairy; abdominal tergites with a few short hairs, sternites with long and short hairs. Body length 3.5–4.5 mm. Head subcircular (0.80–0.85 mm long to base of mandibles, 0.90–1.00 mm maximum width). Fontanelle plate slightly long. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 subequal to segment 2. Postclypeus inflated, less than 1/2 as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.25 mm long, 0.50–0.65 mm wide); anterior margin distinctly notched, posterior margin straight.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule brown with reddish tinge; postclypeus and labrum brownish yellow; antennae yellowish brown; pronotum yellowish brown, much paler than head; legs brownish yellow; abdomen dorsally light brown. Head and body densely hairy. Head capsule subcircular (1.21–1.27 mm wide including compound eyes); Y-shaped suture faint, lateral arms indistinct. Fontanelle plate long. Compound eyes subcircular, large, protruding (0.42–0.45 mm maximum diameter, 0.38–0.40 mm minimum diameter); close to lower margin of head, separated by 0.06–0.08 mm. Ocelli elliptical, very close to compound eyes (0.17–0.18 mm long, 0.13–0.14 mm wide, compound eye–ocellus distance 0.03 mm). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus weakly inflated, narrow, far less than 1/2 as long as wide. Pronotum nearly trapezoidal (0.53–0.57 mm long, 0.91–1.00 mm wide); anterior margin nearly straight, slightly convex at middle, without notch; posterior margin distinctly notched at middle.
